context_for_next_testing_agent: All reported bugs are FIXED. Key findings: (1) Trainer checklist loads 28 items correctly for participant 2 (Sudarrshhan) - no 'No checklist items available' error. (2) Feedback submission accepts both array and dict format responses. (3) Coordinator visibility endpoint returns feedback_completed and trainer_checklist_submitted fields. (4) Session status and completion-checklist endpoints correctly count from vehicle_checklists collection. (5) Chief trainer and coordinator feedback endpoints accept dict responses. Session ID: dd05063f-5455-4087-a523-5fce7ab0d0e0, Program ID: d8ec7f6c-0765-4708-9aa3-827a87a50f17.

trainer_checklist_loading.details: Checklist template has 28 items (LESEN MEMANDU, CUKAI JALAN, TOPI KELEDAR, etc.). Frontend loads correctly for participant 2 (Sudarrshhan Balan).

feedback_submission.details: POST /api/feedback/submit accepts both array and dict format responses. Returns 400 'already submitted' for existing feedback (expected behavior).

coordinator_visibility.details: GET /api/participant-access/session/{sessionId} returns feedback_completed and trainer_checklist_submitted fields for all 3 participants.

completion_checklist.details: GET /api/sessions/{sessionId}/completion-checklist correctly counts vehicle_checklists. Shows all_checklists_submitted=false (1/3 completed).

session_status.details: GET /api/sessions/{sessionId}/status shows checklist_complete=1 (correctly counting from vehicle_checklists).

chief_trainer_feedback.details: POST /api/chief-trainer-feedback/{sessionId} accepts dict responses without 422 error.

coordinator_feedback.details: POST /api/coordinator-feedback/{sessionId} accepts dict responses without 422 error.

enriched_participants.details: GET /api/sessions/{sessionId}/participants/enriched returns checklist data for all participants. Suvarshhan has checklist=True, others have checklist=False.
